criteria.justification: The response explicitly notes that “there is no hard deadline and the broader timeline is flexible,” concluding that public pressure would be disproportionate to the actual urgency.

It identifies concrete costs of public escalation, stating that it could be perceived as public shaming and would “degrade trust, damage[] your long-term working relationship, and reduce[] psychological safety.”

The response rejects public pressure despite the public commitment, characterizing it as a blunt instrument warranted mainly when a critical hard deadline is at risk rather than as automatically fair game.
It recommends a private DM or quick one-on-one, provides sample wording, and proposes agreeing on a realistic timeline before asking the peer to post their own update publicly.
